purpose_note: This page states what the current evidence suggests will keep happening if nothing changes. Every entry is a reasoned judgement, not a proven fact and not a measured probability. Confidence is described in plain terms and every entry states what specific new evidence would revise it. Nothing here is a prediction with a due date, and nothing here should be read as more certain than a person reading the underlying evidence themselves would conclude.

assessments.statement: Absent the six GIPA applications actually being lodged, the petition's six headline numeric claims (50% crime drop, 100+ arrests, 70+ vehicles, six missing people, 30-60 second deployment, helicopter-cost fraction) are likely to keep circulating publicly as accepted fact, unverified, indefinitely.
assessments.basis: Lattice Atlas LP-005: a complete, specific acquisition plan already exists (six drafted GIPA applications) but none had been lodged as at the evidence freeze - the constraint is execution, not evidentiary design.
assessments.confidence_note: Based on the concrete, already-observed gap between a fully drafted acquisition plan and zero applications lodged, not speculation about future NSW Police conduct.
assessments.would_revise_this: The case operator or another party actually lodging one or more of the six GIPA applications, or NSW Police voluntarily publishing the underlying evaluation, cost model, or claim-sourcing documents.

assessments.statement: Absent an external prompt, statewide RPAS expansion (EOI YR-2026-0058) and the Aviation Command Operating Model Review (EOI YR-2026-0012) are likely to proceed to an award or panel decision regardless of whether a complete public Moree trial evaluation is ever published.
assessments.basis: DFAPTA AR-013/CPO-002: both procurement instruments predate the petition and are structurally independent of the trial's own evaluation timeline; the Police Minister's 'assess first' statement and the EOI's 'prepare to scale' publication occurred within days of each other, and Snapshot 7 itself states these are not contradictory since the EOI is market research.
assessments.confidence_note: Based on the documented parallel timing of procurement and evaluation processes, not a stated NSW Police intention to proceed regardless of the evaluation's outcome.
assessments.would_revise_this: A public statement or decision record explicitly making the RPAS Panel or Operating Model Review outcome contingent on the Moree evaluation's findings.

assessments.statement: The reactive/"not surveillance" versus proactive/covert messaging contradiction (CTR-0001) is unlikely to resolve through further NSW Police public statements alone.
assessments.basis: The contradiction has persisted across multiple public statements from February to August 2026 without correction or clarification; it is a policy-documentation gap, not a one-off messaging slip.
assessments.confidence_note: Based on the contradiction's persistence across several months and multiple public occasions, not on any stated NSW Police refusal to clarify.
assessments.would_revise_this: Release of the controlling RPAS/PolAir-Remote operational policy (GIPA Application 2) defining mission classification, which would settle the question directly regardless of further public statements.

assessments.statement: Without a specific external prompt, PolAir-Remote is likely to continue operating past its originally stated six-month window indefinitely, with no public stop/decommissioning decision point becoming visible on its own.
assessments.basis: DFAPTA AR-014: the trial had already continued nearly seven months past its 8 January 2026 commencement (a 2 August 2026 incident) with no located extension notice, and no public stop/failure/decommissioning criteria exist in any material checked.
assessments.confidence_note: Based on an observed continuation past the stated window combined with a documented absence of any public criteria that would trigger a stop decision - not a claim that NSW Police intends indefinite continuation.
assessments.would_revise_this: Publication of a formal trial-closure, transition-to-business-as-usual, or extension decision record (sought in GIPA Application 1).

assessments.statement: A Mid North Coast rollout decision (site selection, dock count, funding) is more likely to be made before a public coverage/feasibility study is published than after.
assessments.basis: DFAPTA AR-017/LP-004: no public feasibility or engineering study for a Mid North Coast deployment currently exists, while statewide capability procurement is already active and the Police Minister has already publicly named Kempsey as a candidate location - the sequencing precedent at Moree (consultation following, not preceding, deployment) supports the same order recurring.
assessments.confidence_note: This projects the Moree sequencing pattern onto a different, not-yet-commenced rollout - a single precedent, not a repeated pattern, so this should not be read as more than a plausible extrapolation.
assessments.would_revise_this: Publication of a Mid North Coast coverage/feasibility study before any site-selection or funding decision is announced.

assessments.statement: The complete 11 August 2026 Macleay Argus article is unlikely to be located through further general web search.
assessments.basis: The article is paywalled and repeated searches across the twelve-snapshot research corpus did not locate its full text; it is a media/publisher record, not a government record, and outside GIPA's reach entirely (explicitly excluded from the GIPA pack for this reason).
assessments.confidence_note: This label applies only to the 'further web search' method. A different method - direct publisher contact, a library subscription database, or an archive service - has not been tried and this assessment says nothing about those.
assessments.would_revise_this: The article surfacing via a library database, an archive service, or direct purchase/subscription access.

assessments.statement: Absent a resident actually discovering and reporting a specific flight, an independent oversight body (LECC, IPC, Ombudsman, Audit Office) is unlikely to publish a PolAir-Remote-specific finding on its own initiative.
assessments.basis: DFAPTA AR-016/CPO-007: LECC has clear systemic jurisdiction and no procedural barrier to self-initiated review is identified in the register, yet no such finding has been published to date, and the practical trigger problem (a resident cannot easily learn a flight occurred) has not changed.
assessments.confidence_note: This is an absence observed once, over a period this investigation cannot precisely bound (the program has operated publicly since February 2026) - it should not be read as proof no internal review is under way.
assessments.would_revise_this: Any published LECC, IPC, Ombudsman, or Audit Office examination of PolAir-Remote, self-initiated or complaint-triggered.

assessments.statement: If the six GIPA applications are lodged, at least partial refusal or redaction on privacy, operational-security, or law-enforcement-sensitivity grounds is likely for some requested material, particularly de-identified mission data and cyber/vendor-risk assessments.
assessments.basis: The GIPA Act's own public-interest balancing test permits withholding for law-enforcement, safety/security, and personal-information harms; the GIPA pack's own scope-exclusion language anticipates this by pre-narrowing requests and explicitly asking for partial access with redactions rather than outright refusal.
assessments.confidence_note: Based on the general operation of GIPA's standard exemption categories as applied to law-enforcement agencies, not on any indication specific to these six applications.
assessments.would_revise_this: Full, unredacted release of any application's requested material, or a published refusal decision citing a specific statutory exemption this assessment can be checked against.

not_claimed: No entry above is a prediction of what will happen by a specific date.
No entry above is a measured probability - the confidence labels are qualitative judgements about how well-supported the pattern is, not statistics.
None of these assessments authorise or compel any action by any institution. They describe what this investigation expects to keep finding if nothing changes, nothing more.

No entry above assumes bad faith on the part of NSW Police, the Police Minister, or Michael Kemp MP - each projects institutional behaviour patterns already visible in the frozen register, not motive.
